WORKS: 1. The recorded panel (700edc91). A recorded floor has an Identifier row: the register read's own
`identifier` of the entry whose id is the floor's registryFloorId, printed whole with the copy
control and never composed. When the register lists no entry for the floor, could not be read, or is
still on its way, the row says so in a sentence. Kind and Area print "Not recorded" where the record
states absent, "Unknown" only where it says unknown (the kind value "unknown" included), withheld
and conflicting by their own word, "Not reported" for a field the read omits, and never a zero. Pure
part floorIdentifier and the state words in recorded/model.ts, a test for each state.
2. Cards across snapshots (24bac39d, 319dcd3e, edc86e88). The card list is read under every snapshot
of the listing's one page, newest first, one read at a time (measured: at most 1 in flight, live and
mocked). Each scope lists every card of the unit, so the demo's one card arrives four times and is
listed once (by card id and revision, the newest snapshot's row kept). Each row says "At its present
revision" or "Changed since this card" from its own snapshotState. Failed reads are counted in one
sentence under the list ("2 of 4 snapshots could not be read."); snapshots the listing left out get
a second sentence. When every card read fails the query fails as before, so nothing is answered as
empty. issueTarget decides from the whole merged list. Two cards of one unit are told apart by a
Card column (first eight characters, whole id as title), drawn only when the rows belong to more
than one card; the row actions always name the card. Pure part mergeUnitCards (api/queries.ts) with
tests.

"The result is unknown: no answer says whether the registry stored anything.", followed by the

server's sentence are left out. Tests: no answer at all; a 502 without a body; a 500 with a code; a
503 USP_POSTWRITE_MISSING. One addition beyond the task: a read that gets no answer during Prepare
now says "The server gave no answer." in place of the browser's words (identity/registryCard.ts).

unit" is a text link at the end of the note; with none listed the link is the one button, as before.

Prepare, the review, snapshot and receipt ids of an assignment, and the floor's identifier carry it.
The packet's sha256 stays text. packages/ui was not changed.
